LanguageData.CL_RedesignSettings_Subtitle: Toggle the screens that Lightweave replaces.
LanguageData.CL_Settings_MainMenu_Redesign_Tip: Replace the vanilla title screen with the Lightweave layout. Disable to fall back to RimWorld's stock menu.
LanguageData.CL_Settings_MainMenu_ParseSaves_Tip: Read the most recent .rws header to surface colony name and tick count on the Continue card. Adds a small one-time disk read.
LanguageData.CL_Settings_Restart_Body: Switching the Lightweave main menu requires restarting RimWorld for the patches to take effect.
